verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is a SaaS payments product that processes merchant and customer transaction data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has nothing on AI-training data use, opt-out controls, or data-usage policy. The MCP server, agent tooling, sandboxes and audit logs are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
